# Moneta (Conatus) - v2.1.0

LibreBugBounty 2.1.0 adds hands-on verification inside the workspace. **Conatus**
means an attempt or effort: when an automatic screenshot is not enough, open a
fresh worker-browser context, interact with it yourself, and retain better evidence.

## Highlights

- **Embedded interactive review:** noVNC streams the dedicated Playwright
  Chromium desktop inside LBB, with optional fullscreen. **Review interactively**
  is always available for eligible cases, even without CAPTCHA detection. Cases
  without a readable image show the interactive panel first; starting it still
  requires an explicit click. Readable evidence retains the existing image viewer.
- **Retained native-dialog evidence:** captured alert/dialog images remain visible
  beside the live browser and can be saved even after that page changes. A dialog
  observation alone is not proof of an image capture or a vulnerability.
- **Explicit handover:** one interactive controller at a time, independent of the
  four automated screenshot lanes. Taking over the same case preserves its browser
  and original 20-minute expiry. Switching cases requires confirmed end-and-start.
- **Clearer worker status:** separate recheck and screenshot panels show queues,
  worker signals, browser-service reachability and per-worker timestamps without
  expanding details. Current case errors are separate from historical job totals.
- **Focused footer tools:** Settings, System status and About have their own entry
  points. About keeps profiles, release history, documentation and support visible;
  both dialogs also have direct-page fallbacks.

## Evidence and operating boundaries

Interactive review is a **fresh retry context**, not a continuation of the original
screenshot browser, cookies or fingerprint. CAPTCHA handling is manual; clearance
is not guaranteed. The application remains intended for a trusted local,
single-user workspace, not an internet-exposed multi-user service.

Opening Review, reloading it or preloading images does not start a browser.
Case/domain restrictions still apply. Saving interactive evidence does not assess
the case: select the stored image as the assessment basis and record your decision
explicitly. After an explicit successful capture, input stays locked through a
failed save or handover until the evidence is saved, the session is cancelled,
or its absolute expiry is reached.

Status is a timestamped snapshot, refreshed only on explicit opening or refresh.
Its bars describe worker signals and browser-service reachability, not workload
capacity, successful target verification or image-file integrity.

## Upgrade from 2.0.3

1. Create and verify a [database and artifact backup](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.1.0/BACKUP.md),
   then stop DDEV and its workers. End or save any interactive work first.
2. Update to **v2.1.0**, retaining your custom storage paths and
   local configuration. Follow the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.1.0/README.md#upgrade-an-existing-workspace)
   to refresh generated worker dependencies while the application is stopped.
3. Include the updated DDEV sidecars, interactive image and Nginx WebSocket/private
   callback configuration. Run `ddev start`; startup installs dependencies and
   applies pending migrations, including `Version20261017000000`, which adds the
   persistent interactive-browser lease and fencing generation.
4. For customized deployments, configure `PLAYWRIGHT_INTERACTIVE_URL`, the shared
   internal `PLAYWRIGHT_WORKER_TOKEN`, and the distinct `PLAYWRIGHT_GATEWAY_TOKEN`
   consistently. Keep worker/RFB/websockify ports private and configure the allowed
   public origin. The checked-in credentials are for local development only; see
   the [worker operating guide](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.1.0/playwright-worker/README.md).
5. Reload the UI, open **System status**, and verify existing cases and evidence.
   Test interactive review on an authorized case before relying on the new workflow.

Do not reset the database or downgrade the fencing migration in place. For rollback,
restore the matching pre-upgrade database and artifact snapshot into a separate
recovery directory with the corresponding earlier application version.

## Verification scope

The implementation has local PHP, worker/gateway and browser regression coverage,
including takeover fencing, retained evidence, no-JS fallbacks and visible status
states. A real DDEV same-origin WSS flow was exercised with a synthetic local target,
native alert capture, explicit save and a parallel automated screenshot.

Release publication is gated on GitHub CI for the exact release commit: the full
PHP suite, worker/gateway tests, dependency audits, backup tests and isolated
Studio/noVNC browser suites. Real Cloudflare CAPTCHA clearance and every
production outage scenario have not been established by those synthetic tests.
